meta_cites_state_law_006.evidence: TEC§ Sec. 25.085 states that “a child shall attend school each school day for the entire period the program of instruction is provided”. A school day shall be at least seven hours each day, including intermissions and recesses (TEC§ Sec. 25.082). A child shall not have unexcused absences on 10 or more days or parts of days within a six month period in the same school year or on three or more days or parts of days within a four-week period from school (Family Code Sec. 51.03).
